detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera holds a static shot. His throat moves once as he swallows, his gaze staying down on the bottle in his hand; his lower lip presses flat. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, comes in Mandarin Chinese from off-screen, fast and indignant, while the man visible in frame keeps his lips closed and still,: <d>[Chinese] 趁你下井查工作的功夫，偷偷塞进你办公室抽屉，</d> while their lips remain completely closed. His gaze slides down from the left of frame until it rests on the bottle in his own hand; the muscle along his jaw draws tight once and stays tight, and his chest rises and falls slowly. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, from off-screen, dropping to a flat hard finish, while the man in frame stays silent,: <d>[Chinese] 转头就匿名报了警。</d> while their lips remain completely closed. his own slow breathing.

overall_soundscape:
His own slow breathing.
